senses.gloss: to soften the skin by ointment, bathing &c.; to feel comfortable.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 25a:14">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>יהיבנא לך</he> … <he>דמְעַנְּגַת בהון</he> I shall give thee, in the world to come, thirteen rivers of balsam oil clear as Euphrates and Tigris in which thou shalt find pleasure.
<cite ref="Genesis 2">B’resh. 2</cite> <he>לעַנּוּגֵיה במאכל וכ׳</he> to celebrate it (the Sabbath) joyfully with eating &c.
